name: Nakafurano (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakafurano town emblem in yellow, green and black: a yellow broken ring of concentric arcs enclosing a green stylised leaf above a black base.
history: Municipal flag of Nakafurano, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1962.

features.role: Nakafurano town emblem — a yellow broken ring of concentric arcs enclosing a green stylised leaf above a black base
